record.dic_text:
03750 karkom {kar-kome'}

可能源自外來語; TWOT - 1039; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - saffron 1; 1

1) 番紅花 (#歌 4:14|)
   1a) "番紅花"科中的一種橘黃色的花, 用於飲料和甜點中調味, 可促進流汗幫助身體散熱
record.edic_text:
03750 karkom {kar-kome'}

probably of foreign origin; TWOT - 1039; n m

AV - saffron 1; 1

1) saffron
   1a) an orange-yellow flower of the crocus family, used for flavouring
      in drinks and confections in order to promote perspiration for
      cooling of the body
